# Criterion roll-up: audit

**As of 2026-10-23** · Source: live files, runs and data named in each row · Generated by: `scripts/audit_criterion_rollup.py`

**Generated 2026-10-23 by `scripts/audit_criterion_rollup.py`, never hand-written.** Every number below was computed from live files, runs and data on that date. **V** verified, **A** assumed, **B** broken or missing. The five fixes from the first audit have shipped; each row says what is true now.

```
  scenario criteria (plan)     UAT lists        guards markers / evals       PR review    smoke
        |                        |                      |                      |           |
        v                        v                      v                      v           v
  criterion report <--- agent run: regen-criterion-report (one per feature, build-log/reports/)
        |   rows: Built, Reviewed per criterion; roll-up lines GENERATED from the rows
        v
  scripts/criteria.py: Checked = markers.py (same as STATUS); Smoked = green smoke after last merge;
        |             PM looked = pm-reviewed; stale = merged after the report
        |-----------------> handoff/capabilities.md
        v
  rollup(): criterion -> feature -> area -> milestone  (plain sums of criteria)
        v
  dashboard.py (every 6 h by workflow): header = criteria met / total; area cards; features; Issue count alongside
        v
  DASHBOARD.md + status-dashboard.html  ->  Friday launch report
```

## 5. How it lands on the dashboard

- **Header:** "# Beta 11-06 · 7 days to freeze · criterion roll-up: 188/285 criteria met (66%), checked 116, reviewed 28, smoked 0, PM looked 0 across 34 features, 1 red, 0 reports stale · Issues closed 137/156 (alo". **V**
- **Color ramp:** five steps, red to green, on criteria met / total, per feature and per area. **V**
- **Red rule:** a feature or area is red when an unmet criterion links an open `launch-blocking` Issue. **V**; 5 features red: F076, F058, F077, F081, F103.
- **Stale flag:** a feature whose last merged PR is newer than its report is flagged. **V**; 1 stale now: F114.
- **Per criterion:** built, checked (T), reviewed (R), smoked (S), PM looked (P) on each criterion row, with links to its Issues and the full report. **V**
- **Coverage:** 34 features have criterion-level results, of 34 reportable. Only 33 of the 162 milestone items are scenario Issues (20%).
- **Headline numbers in circulation:** criteria met 195 of 291 (the beta %), Issues closed 137 of 162 (alongside), and `handoff/latest.md`'s own count (Dispatch-written, **A**).

**Still open:**
1. **No PM review results.** 0 of 291 criteria are PM-looked; 0 real UAT Issues have been closed; `#519` has 4 checkboxes.
2. **Smoke is red** (last green 2026-10-23), so "Smoked" is a stale claim and no criterion is evidenced beyond page loads.
3. **129 of 162 milestone items have no criteria** (changes, bugs, chores).
4. **Checked is 40%** (116 of 291); most criteria have no marked test.
5. **Report text can still be stale or wrong**: the rows are agent-written once and refreshed on the Friday run; a row can be wrong until then (the stale flag only catches merges, not edits to a scenario).
